rule: R1 Keep flagged fixtures IN the primary aggregate of their stratum. No flagged fixture carries a mechanism claim. No fixture is excluded (excluded_from_primary_aggregate stays empty).

R2 Pre-registered leave-flagged-out sensitivity: every primary statistic, screen and reading is recomputed without the flagged fixtures (attempt-2 flags in stratum S; in-session flags in either stratum) and reported beside the primary, never instead of it. The direction screen then uses ceil(0.75 x n) of the n remaining fixtures.

R3 Fixture flags are counted by position as well as by layer-unit: a gross position is a (fixture, pool) gross in at least one DSA layer of either rank. The attempt-2 definitions (outside own null: gross_f > max(2 x max(N_dd_f, N_pp_f), 0.1 %) with >= 10 gross units; arm asymmetry on units shared by both B1 arms and N_pp) are evaluated twice, once with layer-units and once with positions as the unit (>= 3 gross positions replacing >= 10 gross units). Both counts are reported; a flag on either count marks the fixture flagged.

R4 be2e9e349395's 13 three-way-reproducible gross units (known_fragile_be2e9e349395.json) are a known fragile set: they are reported separately, and any pool-level effect located on them is attributed first to pre-existing decode-vs-prefill numerics. In stratum S the index-K content rows are reported with and without these units.
R5 In-session flags on the long fixtures (after data) follow R1-R3: the fixture stays in the primary aggregate, carries no mechanism claim, and is dropped in the R2 sensitivity.
